capabilities: Search file names, paths, aliases, headings, tags and note contents
Define launcher buttons for commands, files, folders, searches and URLs
Append quick-capture lines to the daily note or a chosen file
Show recent files and bookmarks in list, dropdown, card or pill layouts
Display a daily or random quote above the title
disambiguation: Not a system app launcher; its buttons create notes, run Obsidian commands, reveal folders, run searches, or open URLs.
extras: Two release lines: 1.2.0 for Obsidian 1.13.0+ and 1.0.2 for 1.11.0–1.12.x, where settings use the older API and paths are typed by hand. README states no network requests, telemetry or analytics.
motivation: The author wanted buttons treated as data the user configures, because most home page plugins give a fixed set of blocks and adding one means waiting for the author or bolting on a second plugin.
problem: Obsidian's new tabs are blank, and home page plugins with fixed blocks force users to wait for the author or add a second plugin to get a new button.

relations.evidence: If you already use the separately installed Omnisearch community plugin, you can choose Omnisearch instead
If the community Periodic Notes plugin is on with daily notes enabled, its settings are used

summary: Custom new-tab home page with vault-wide search, user-defined launcher buttons, quick capture, a daily quote, and recent files and bookmarks.
